name: Shiroya Tool Lab
description: Developer utilities platform and tool laboratory built by Vraj Shiroya (VG31OP). Featuring client-side web tools, server-backed website scrapers, and desktop network utilities.

tools.name: Web Shiroya
tools.description: Website crawler and source downloader that crawls web pages and packages HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and assets into a downloadable ZIP archive.
tools.privacy: URL processing and website mirroring execute on a server worker; downloaded assets are written to temporary job directories during archive generation.

tools.name: Drop
tools.description: Encrypted peer-to-peer file transfer engine using WebRTC RTCDataChannel with DTLS encryption.
tools.privacy: Zero cloud storage; files stream directly between peer browser instances.

tools.name: BgZero
tools.description: Client-side AI image background remover and transparent PNG export utility.
tools.privacy: 100% local browser execution using client-side canvas and vision models.

tools.name: PDF Tools
tools.description: In-memory browser PDF merger, splitter, page organizer, and compression utility.
tools.privacy: In-memory WebAssembly processing; confidential documents are never uploaded to remote servers.

tools.name: Network-Speed-Combiner
tools.description: Desktop download manager application that splits file downloads into chunks across concurrent network adapters (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, cellular) to accelerate completion.
tools.privacy: Local desktop execution; download chunks stream directly through local network adapters to assemble the target file.
